name: Bierkopf
summary: Bavarian 4-player partnership point-trick game, a simple Schafkopf variant played for beer where teams race to erase 21 lines.
rules_text: Bierkopf uses 20 cards from a Bavarian pack: all 4 Obers, 4 Unters, Ace, 10, King of Hearts and Ace, 10, King of Acorns, Leaves, Bells. Trumps rank Obers Acorns>Leaves>Hearts>Bells, then Unters in same order, then A-10-K of Hearts. Non-trump suits rank A>10>K. Points: A=11, 10=10, K=4, O=3, U=2, total 120. Four players in two fixed partnerships opposite. Partners found by dealing face-up until two Sows appear. Dealer shuffles and deals 5 cards each in packets 3+2. Before play, forehand confers briefly with partner about strength without naming cards. Either side may announce Schuss/Spritze to double the game value. After second card to second trick, side may announce Retoure to double again; this can repeat. Play: forehand leads, must follow suit if possible, else must trump if possible, else discard. Highest trump wins, else highest of led suit. 5 tricks per hand. Team with >60 card points erases 1 line of its 21, <30 for losers is Schneider for 2 lines, winning all tricks is Schwarz for 3 lines, multiplied by doubles. First to erase all 21 wins the Bollen.
